data.description: Upgraded 3BR Townhouse | Near Pool & Gym | Brand New
data.display_address: Aura Gardens, Tilal Al Ghaf, Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate proudly presents this just handed over three-bedroom plus maid’s townhouse, offering a well-balanced layout and contemporary living in Aura Gardens, Tilal Al Ghaf.

The home features a maid’s room, a private garden, and a balcony, ideal for both comfort and practicality. Located close to the community pool and gym, residents benefit from convenient access to key amenities within a well-planned neighbourhood. The property includes covered parking, is offered unfurnished, and is available for immediate occupancy.

• Well-designed townhouse combining comfort and functionality
• Three spacious, naturally bright bedrooms offering privacy and ease of living
• Just handed over – brand new condition
• Clean, modern bathrooms with quality fittings
• Practical layout with comfortable indoor and outdoor flow
• Unfurnished – a perfect blank canvas to personalise
• Includes maid’s room, balcony, and private garden
• Covered, secure parking for residents
• Excellent location close to community amenities including pool, gym, parks, and walking paths

For more details and to arrange a viewing, reach out today.
